title: UVM: Coverage Placement in the Env
constraints: Write `class my_env extends uvm_env` with public handles `bus_agent agent`, `bus_sb sb` and `bus_cov cov`.

In `build_phase`: read `int has_coverage` from `uvm_config_db#(int)` (field `"has_coverage"`, default **1** when not set). Always create `agent` and `sb`. Create `cov` only when coverage is enabled, and leave it `null` otherwise. Create every component through the **factory**.
In `connect_phase`: connect `agent.mon.ap` to `sb.imp`, and to `cov.analysis_export` when `cov` exists.
The hidden test builds three envs (coverage on, off, and not configured) and installs a factory override for `bus_cov`.
hints: `void'(uvm_config_db#(int)::get(this, "", "has_coverage", has_coverage));` leaves the default untouched if nothing was set.
`bus_cov::type_id::create("cov", this)` honors type overrides, while `new("cov", this)` silently ignores them.
Coverage belongs in the env (or a dedicated coverage component), not in the agent: agents are reused across projects, and coverage models are project-specific.
